entities.description: A full-body shot of a dark-skinned man walking forward on a dirt path, wearing traditional African attire including a beaded necklace, armbands, and a woven loincloth with a fringe. He has a shaved head adorned with a single feather headdress and is barefoot with a white bandage wrapped around his right ankle.

clothing.necklace: multi-strand beaded, red, white, and blue
clothing.loincloth: woven, tan with red stripes, fringed front

attributes.background: dirt path, blurred trees and sky

entities.description: A full-body shot of a standing Black man with dark skin, wearing traditional African attire including a beaded necklace, a woven loincloth, and a single black feather headdress. He holds a long wooden staff in his right hand and has his left hand on his hip, with white wrappings on his ankles and green bands on his arms and leg.

clothing.anklets: white cloth wrappings on both ankles
clothing.arm_bands: beige band on right upper arm, green band on left upper arm
clothing.bracelet: white beaded bracelet on left wrist

entities.description: A full-body profile shot of a dark-skinned man standing against a textured brown background, wearing traditional indigenous attire including a white and red beaded necklace, a white armband, a white loincloth with red and yellow patterns, and white leg wraps. He has a shaved head adorned with a headband and a single black and white feather, and his body is painted with dark pigment.

clothing.loincloth: white with red and yellow patterned waistband
